Company profile

The ticker HUG.WA represents HubStyle S.A., a company listed on the Warsaw Stock Exchange. Historically, the business evolved from a traditional fashion retailer operating online storefronts into an enterprise focusing on the e-commerce sector. Over the years, the company underwent strategic shifts, including restructuring initiatives and asset realignments, to adapt to the competitive retail and digital marketplace environments in Poland. Please note that market statuses and company profiles are subject to change due to ongoing corporate restructuring, mergers, or potential delistings on the Warsaw Stock Exchange.
